items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: We got to sending one another Christmas cards, oh, I'd say about eight or ten years ago.

ctx.x: And of course, last year I didn't send her a card, because Liscotte(?) passed away during the year, and I didn't send out any Christmas cards at all. So as far as I'm concerned, she don't know that Liscotte(?) has passed away. I don't know if she knows or not. I guess so. But I'll send her a card this year, if she's still around to receive it. Nice person, Alma. Very nice.
